desc.hr: Aktivno upravljan novčani fond: ulaže u instrumente tržišta novca (primarno trezorske zapise RH, Francuske i drugih članica EU/OECD-a) i depozite, s ciljem prinosa iznad kratkoročnih stopa tržišta novca uz visoku likvidnost; referentna vrijednost je €STR indeks ECB-a.
desc.en: An actively managed money-market fund: it invests in money-market instruments (primarily treasury bills of Croatia, France and other EU/OECD members) and deposits, aiming for returns above short-term money-market rates with high liquidity; the benchmark is the ECB's €STR index.

posts.body_hr: Tema: InterCapital Euro Money Market UCITS ETF (7CASH). Činjenice (tečajnica ZSE; factsheet za srpanj 2026.): 1) Aktivno upravljan novčani ETF: ulaže u instrumente tržišta novca (pretežno trezorske zapise Francuske i drugih članica EU/OECD-a) i depozite; referentna vrijednost je €STR indeks ECB-a. 2) Zadnja cijena na ZSE 107,28 € (30. 7.) — oznaka zastarjele cijene stoji jer se fondom trguje rijetko; vrijednost obračunske jedinice 107,2943 €. 3) Neto imovina 37,1 mil. €; TER 0,32 % godišnje; na ZSE uvršten 25. 10. 2023. 4) Prinos: ove godine (YTD) +1,06 % naspram +1,17 % za €STR; 2024. +3,43 % naspram +3,80 %. 5) Portfelj (srpanj 2026.): francuski trezorski zapisi ~78 %, depozit OTP 11,5 %; prosječni prinos do dospijeća 2,38 %, prosječno dospijeće 2,7 mjeseci. 6) Likvidnost na ZSE: trgovano 60 od 250 radnih dana.
posts.body_en: Topic: InterCapital Euro Money Market UCITS ETF (7CASH). Facts (ZSE price list; July 2026 factsheet): 1) An actively managed money-market ETF: it invests in money-market instruments (mostly treasury bills of France and other EU/OECD members) and deposits; the benchmark is the ECB's €STR index. 2) Last ZSE price EUR 107.28 (30 Jul) — the stale-price flag stands because the fund trades rarely; unit value EUR 107.2943. 3) Net assets EUR 37.1M; TER 0.32% a year; listed on the ZSE since 25 Oct 2023. 4) Returns: this year (YTD) +1.06% versus +1.17% for €STR; 2024 +3.43% versus +3.80%. 5) Portfolio (July 2026): French treasury bills ~78%, an OTP deposit 11.5%; average yield to maturity 2.38%, average maturity 2.7 months. 6) ZSE liquidity: traded on 60 of 250 working days.
